interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to enable NDP proxy on. Each entry configures one interface.

name.description: Name of the interface (e.g., eth0, br-lan). Required.

enabled.description: Whether NDP proxy is active on this interface. Set to false to disable.

prefixes.description: List of IPv6 prefixes to announce via NDP proxy (i.e., respond to neighbor solicitations for).

address.description: IPv6 address of the prefix (e.g., 2001:db8:1::). Required.

length.description: Prefix length in bits (typically 64 for subnets).

interface.description: Interface through which to proxy replies for this prefix (e.g., br-lan). Required.

enabled.description: Whether this prefix is actively proxied. Set to false to disable.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the npd6 daemon.

debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output (use only for troubleshooting).
